answer: Require every agent wallet to lock a stake that scales with its transaction volume, so a sybil swarm must split capital across identities until each share falls below the cost of one honest delta of throughput. Layer a reputation graph seeded by mutual attestation: trust flows like ocean currents carrying only well-behaved nodes forward, and newcomers enter through a lotus-rooted vouching tree where each introducer risks its own stake if the newcomer turns malicious. Cheap fake identities become unprofitable while honest entrants join with modest collateral.
